title: Review of c46's hunting ecology on fresh seed 71 (256^2, matched twin) and a 128^2 fuel-cut gate: X, predator D and prey E replicate, but on different kinds; prey make 1 persistent split and predators no persistent track
summary: Labkit re-run of the claim's world.py on seed 71 at 256^2 (120 frames, t=12000, --lineage-k 5) with its matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0), and a fuel-cut fork (fork_t 6000) against a fed run at 128^2 (75 frames). With predators: prey 58 -> 1 (t~3000) -> 58 (t~5500) -> 16 at the end; prey condensed area 0.060 vs 0.150 in the twin (mean t>=4000); prey 35 vs 70 bodies. Predators: 19 persistent splits (K=5), generation 2, rods and Y-shapes pinching after meals (sheet t=6800-11500), but 0 persistent tracks (they dim between meals). Prey: 1 persistent split, generation 1, against 23 persistent splits in the twin. Fork: prey 18 -> 0 within 500 t with mean prey material 0.240 -> 0.235 (kept), predators 10 -> 8; fed run keeps 11-20 prey; both arms identical to t=6000.

observations.S: rerun/seed71/sheet.png t=0: unstructured noise over the whole domain
observations.X: xcompare71.png, controls/twin_seed71: prey number 35 vs 70 and condensed area 0.060 vs 0.150 (t>=4000), a crash to 1 prey at t~3000 and a recovery to 58, against a twin that grows to 90; sign on prey negative, predators need prey
observations.D: rerun/seed71/FACTS.md: predators 19 persistent splits (K=5), generation 2; prey only 1 (twin 23)
observations.E: controls/efork_seed71_128 vs controls/fed_seed71_128: prey 18 -> 0 within 500 t of the fuel cut, material kept; fed 11-20

seeds_run.result: X, predator D and prey E reproduce; prey D and predator I do not

controls_run.X: controls/twin_seed71 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration and window)
controls_run.E: controls/efork_seed71_128 (fork_t 6000) vs controls/fed_seed71_128 (same seed, run alongside)

verdicts.limitation: The capabilities sit on different kinds, as c55 found. E (dissolution after a supply cut, matter kept) is the prey's, and the predators' E is by construction because they are made only from prey material. D is the predators': prey made 1 persistent split here, while the twin's prey made 23, so predation suppresses prey division. Predators have no persistent labkit track (0 of 230 tracks live half the run), so their I is thin. One fresh seed; the fork is at 128^2.
